1. Analyze the target codebase to identify: technology stack, styling approach, component patterns, and design tokens
2. Convert React syntax to the target framework/library

Component descriptions: The following components have usage descriptions or documentation links defined in Figma. These descriptions provide important context about the intended usage, best practices, and any constraints for each component. Follow these guidelines when implementing or using these components.

## Analytify/Route glows
**Node ID:** 529:21518

Route glows animate between destination layouts independently of the persistent particle loop. On first document render, establish the destination immediately without a document view transition from an empty page. Animate subsequent in-app destination changes; preserve the independent particle loop and reduced-motion treatment. Responsive application contract: preserve the native ellipse asset sizes and baked opacity: desktop green1400x1050 at0.11/blue1280x1050 at0.065, mobile<=760px green720x760 at0.09/blue630x760 at0.05. Use the normalized ellipse centers from each canonical viewport/Scene to anchor them in short/tall and resized windows; do not stretch the SVGs. Library/Insights/Social centers normalize identically across viewport variants; League uses its own desktop/mobile centers. Map library routes to Library, stats/history to Insights, friends/sharing/comparison to Social and Song League to League; account/admin/public/default reuse Library. Keep one persistent renderer and particle timeline. Scroll/overlay opening must not move glow centers. Retain existing overlay and shell dimming as a wrapper multiplier, without multiplying the native asset opacity again. Resizing refreshes viewport layout immediately; reduced motion updates destination immediately. Smooth subsequent scene movement retains existing damped route interpolation, including interrupted-navigation recovery.

## Analytify/Ambient background
**Node ID:** 266:18224

Large green and blue glows are fixed within a page, including during scrolling. Glow positions change only on page navigation, with a smooth route transition. Particle phases loop continuously over 24 seconds; all phases within one Scene have identical glow positions, size and opacity. Shared backdrop behind opaque cards and navigation. Mobile uses fewer and softer dots. Still variant provides reduced motion. Implementation must preserve one shell-level background: scroll can move dots but must never modify glow coordinates. Application handoff: preserve one particle timeline across navigation and overlays, using the same normalized phase coordinates in every Scene. Desktop has 26 dots; mobile has 12. Each A-to-B, B-to-C and C-to-A leg lasts 8 seconds with ease-in-out, forming a continuous 24-second loop. The prototype 50ms AFTER\_TIMEOUT trigger advances the variant graph; do not add idle gaps to the application loop. Still uses Phase A positions without animation. Resize preserves loop phase; hidden documents pause the timeline and resume it on return.

## Size=Expanded
**Node ID:** 62:2590

Shared desktop navigation rail with a softly rounded inset surface and gentle shadow. Visual surface is independent of layout: icon and section-label center remains X=33 in both expanded and collapsed modes; logo center remains Y=24, matching the top bar. Logo still toggles expansion. Profile stays at the bottom.

## Analytify/Desktop sidebar
**Node ID:** 869:73478

Shared desktop sidebar: Expanded256px and Compact98px states. Brand is one native keyboard-operable toggle with expanded state and accessible action name. Route destinations keep their accessible names and selected-route indicator in compact mode. Navigation list scrolls independently in short windows; profile remains at the bottom and opens Settings. Collapse state survives child-route navigation and never collapses the always-expanded mobile menu. Administrator destination is exposed only for confirmed administrator access. User-authored motion remains provisional: preserve Figma prototype actions unchanged; static responsive/keyboard state implementation may proceed, motion parity remains explicitly incomplete until settled.

## Analytify/Page heading
**Node ID:** 139:7724

Shared identity region for every full page. Desktop: Display heading, Body description, 8 px gap. Mobile: Heading title, optional description, 8 px gap. Primary actions may sit beside this component on desktop or in the content toolbar on mobile. Page padding is 32 px desktop / 16 px mobile; the following content starts 16 px / 12 px after the header. Do not add per-page offsets or headings above this component.

## Analytify/Navigation / Back
**Node ID:** 241:14393
